ns2:section.sectionText: Recent developments in learning-based robotics. The course starts with an overview of background from relevant subfields: computer vision, machine learning, robotics and control theory. Next, we discuss advanced techniques for learning policies for robots, such as model-free reinforcement learning with function approximators, model learning, model-based RL with learned models, imitation learning, inverse reinforcement learning, self-supervised learning, exploration, and hierarchical reinforcement learning. The course will conclude with case-studies on robotic navigation, and manipulation from recent papers.
